original_text: Agent coordination: agents working in this repository should coordinate with each other instead of only excluding each other. Add (1) friendly agent names and a roster of who is working on what; (2) an inter-agent message bus (direct, broadcast and per-request messages) that works peer-to-peer now and lets a coordinator/lead agent be added later as just another participant; (3) a web control panel run by a Python script, with full control (start/stop/recover/enable/disable workers, set priority, send operator messages), localhost by default; (4) a live CLI dashboard; both must show the messages agents send to each other; (5) support for mixed fleets: Claude Code and opencode major versions 1 and 2, selectable per worker; (6) all of it must work with git worktrees (shared state across worktrees, each agent's worktree/branch visible).
context: Chat brainstorm 2026-11-14. Operator decisions: opencode 1 and 2 = two major versions; coordination = peer-to-peer now, lead later; panel scope = full control; process = baseline commit then full request process. Follow-up chat message: 'and support git work trees'.
